guides.favoredWhen: She dodges everything and camps brush after 6. Vary spells, check bushes, match roams.

keyTips.text: She dodges spells and never face-checks: vary the timing.
After 6 you clear waves: the duel ends, the map begins.
She camps brush when the map is known: check every brush.

tips.text: Your E checks bushes: E brush before entering.
She trades on dodges: every sidestep is her opening, so hold spells.
She buys Mercs when struggling: tenacity answers bindings, so land Q first.
Match her clears with roams: wave met wave means move.
Bound plus cleared: the Akali who never dodges never wins.

sources.author: Anguish333
sources.rankClaim: Master (profile badge; title claims 2000LP GrandMaster EUW and Challenger EUNE) · Akali main

guides.favoredWhen: She forces the wave-choice and converts every miss. Hold Q for dashes, shove to roam.

keyTips.text: She never stands with the wave: aim Qs where she must dodge to.
Her dash is your Q target: after one dash, bind her.
She dodges E then shoves: hold E for guaranteed hits.

tips.text: She fights for the wave with autos: match autos, keep E threat.
She answers E-catches by shoving: never throw E without a plan.
After 6 she respects bind into combo: Q then R wins.
She shoves to pin you: clear fast, roam before forced to base.
Her misses are her windows: a Lux who never misses never loses.

sources.author: PekinWoof
sources.rankClaim: Challenger (video title and outro) · Lux main

guides.favoredWhen: She builds a pre-6 lead and answers wave-ults. Survive early, ult waves after 6.

keyTips.text: She builds a lead before 6: the lane is decided early, so do not concede it.
After 6 you ult waves and neutralize: a conceding Syndra is your win condition.
Her tier-2 boots rush: lead Qs, never throw straight.

tips.text: She pressures pre-6 with Q-E: respect the threat range.
Every sidestep compounds her lead: vary Q-E patterns.
She answers your wave-ults with pressure: make neutral cost her.
She keeps dodging: boots plus movement are her whole defense, so hold spells.
Pre-6 survived plus waves ulted: the Syndra whose lead never banked never threatens.

guides.favoredWhen: He engages the moment Q misses and never Rs into it. Hold Q, vary E, end it.

keyTips.text: Your Q enables everything: a missed Q removes most of your threat, so hold it.
He never Rs while your Q is up: the held binding is your shield.
He engages when you spend Q: the cooldown is his entire window, so vary it.

early-lane.text: Zed often places Living Shadow before Death Mark so he can swap away from skillshots. Hold your crowd control until he has used the swap.

win-condition.text: Death Mark always lands Zed behind his target. Pre-aim crowd control and escapes behind you, not toward where he cast it.

tips.text: He dodges E at max range: change the angle, never the timing.
Your Q-E-R converts a single binding: fish, never force.
Death Mark always lands Zed behind his target. Pre-aim crowd control and escapes behind you, not toward where he cast it.
His Edge of Night blanks one Q: bait the shield before committing.
Shield baited plus Q landed: the Zed whose Edge never blanks you never kills you.

keyTips.text: Last-hit routinely with basic attacks and hold the wave stable; habitual spell clearing wastes mana, invites ganks, and drops farm.
Spend spells on waves only to secure cannons, catch crashes under tower, or build priority before objectives and roams.
Follow allied area engages with R across grouped teams instead of saving it purely for single low-health finishes.

tips.text: Against melee opponents, auto them on step-up CS attempts and hold a freeze while respecting their threatening spells and extra minion aggro.
Never donate a valuable last hit just to land one more auto on the opponent.
Roam with pushed waves toward extended bot lanes and no camps worth taking; never leave while the own wave crashes inward.
On enemy mid roams, ping both sides and hold vision before following; never walk blind into a mobile opponent path.
Answer unsafe-to-follow roams by shoving mid for plates, banking gold and experience over late arrivals.
Take nearby Raptors only after pushing out far enough to return, before a healthy mana-filled recall, or on explicit jungler permission.
Chip vulnerable opponents with E before teams commit to ease the coming engage.
Aim burst at the enemy ADC or mage when possible over the first rooted tank, respecting defensive answers that can block it.
Peel divers off the ADC by shielding with W and rooting attackers with Q so the carry keeps firing.

keyTips.text: Shove safely, then poke E so the enemy ADC picks between eating damage and collecting farm.
Play without a reliable escape in these setups, keeping distance after spending Q or E.
Hunt catches and burst over front-to-back anchoring; Lux never plays the sustained team anchor.

tips.text: Match E poke to First Strike windows and repeat the trade as the rune returns.
Spend the passive mark with a safe basic attack whenever one opens.
Ride Shurelya's Battlesong plus Boots of Swiftness movement to reposition, escape, and rotate faster.
Track enemy squishies and ward likely catch routes, since vision sets up Lux own picks.
Watch the minimap and rotate after shoves; supports never need to stay for last hits.
Stay off enemy vision before catch attempts the team can follow.
Bind and burst squishy targets, then leave on movement speed before opponents turn back.
Check the team needs an AP damage support before locking Lux; composition comes first.
Snowball early leads and close before prolonged fights, where she fades.

itemization.text: Run Aery with Manaflow Band, Celerity, and Scorch plus Cheap Shot and Relentless Hunter, picking movement speed for map safety and speed.
Build Shurelya's Battlesong into Boots of Swiftness and Stormsurge, recovering AP cheaply with Dark Seal after the mobility rush.
Run Arcane Comet with Manaflow Band, Absolute Focus, and Gathering Storm plus Cash Back and Jack of All Trades, with First Strike as the repeated-poke and gold alternative.
Build Stormsurge first for burst into Sorcerer's Shoes and Shadowflame, then Rabadon's Deathcap and Cryptbloom in the order that completes Jack of All Trades and Cash Back bonuses efficiently.
Pick Zaz'Zak's Realmspike as the default support item, or Celestial Opposition into assassins.
